anchors: A pattern must also MISS every other refusal the code can raise.
so a pattern for the inner rule also passes when the wrapper fires
decision: A pytest.raises match= pattern must match its own refusal and no other the code can raise: check it with re.search against every raise message in the module and the layers it calls, anchor an inner rule's pattern against a wrapper that interpolates it, and give a test-raised sentinel a whole-matched sentence.

evidence.text: A scan of one library's suite flagged 42 single-token patterns; recording every refusal message the suite raised (551) showed several patterns, and a new alternation pattern, matching unrelated refusals of the same package. RED arms (opus, haiku) on the pre-edit text both listed the missing neighbour check as a skill gap; GREEN arms on both tiers rejected the loose patterns quoting the new sentence.

reopen_if: pytest changes match= from re.search to a full match, or a shipped tool checks every pattern against the code's refusal set automatically in the gate.
why: match= is re.search, so a word several refusals share passes whichever fires and the test stays green when the code refuses for the wrong reason. The earlier text only said to match the validator's phrase and allowed any substring every arm shares.

anchors: A budget the code spends waiting on a stand-in that must ANSWER is roomy
decision: A budget the code spends waiting on a stand-in that must answer is roomy; only a test expecting expiry keeps a tight one; a pacing TCP stand-in turns Nagle off and the test asserts the outcome class and reported == on-disk bytes, never bytes-within-budget.

evidence.text: Pre-edit text check: 0 hits for Nagle/NODELAY. GREEN opus and haiku: both fixed the trickle test (Nagle off, outcome plus on-disk bytes) and the 1 s vote budget, and left the expiring-budget control alone, quoting the bullet.

reopen_if: A suite following this still flakes on stand-in timing, or a roomy budget hides a real hang.
why: A 1 s budget let one stall on a loaded host flip an unrelated vote about once in three full runs; with Nagle on, macOS delivered 6 of 18 trickled bytes where Linux and Windows delivered all, costing two red CI rounds.

anchors: with every inherited `GIT_*` variable removed first
RED one arm per sink: in a scratch copy
assert an outcome only the timed wake produces
decision: Three defeater entries: a fresh-home commit test sets GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_* in a child env stripped of inherited GIT_* with XDG_CONFIG_HOME under the temp dir; a refused-before-side-effect test asserts every sink, RED one arm per sink; a timed-wake test uses a case only the timeout can wake, asserts an outcome only the timed wake produces, and bounds the untimed-wait arm.

evidence.text: Pre-edit text check: 0 hits for _AUTHOR_/_COMMITTER_, untimed, every sink. GREEN opus and haiku found each seeded defect; gaps closed (zero-completed outcome, bounded arm, GIT_* strip, untouched defined) and a haiku re-run on the final text applied all three.

reopen_if: A test written to one of these entries still passes against the defect it names.
why: Each passed locally and failed in CI or survived a mutation: a commit test red only on a runner with no identity, a zero-timeout test green while every proxy was banned, an untimed-wait mutant surviving a many-short-items test.
